slots.notes: Fullscreen looping muted autoplay HLS background video sitting behind all content at -z-10, 100% opacity with no dark overlay; delivered as an .m3u8 stream consumed via hls.js.
Row of 3 overlapping customer/user avatar portraits with ring borders, shown beside the 'Trusted by 210k+ stores worldwide' social-proof text.
Brand wordmark/logo at the left of the navbar; needs transparency, monochrome to read against the dark navbar.
lucide-react UI glyphs: the arrow that slides into the primary button on hover, and the hamburger/menu icon for the mobile nav dropdown.
Display/heading typeface 'Switzer' (Medium weight, tight tracking) for the navbar logo text and large hero headline.
Body typeface 'Geist' (clean, legible) for subhead, nav links, button labels, and social-proof copy.

mechanic: Fullscreen hls.js background video behind a dark hero whose text, buttons, and social-proof stagger in with a motion/react fade-up + slide on load, over a gradient glow primary button that scales and reveals a sliding arrow on hover.
techDelivery: React (Vite) + Tailwind CSS + motion/react (Framer Motion) + lucide-react, with native HTML5 video streamed via hls.js (no react-player).
reskinNotes: Brand accents are baked into Tailwind arbitrary-value classes rather than tokens: the 5px top bar gradient (from-[#ccf] via-[#e7d04c] to-[#31fb78]) and the primary button gradient (from-[#FF3300] to-[#EE7926]) plus its bg-orange-600 glow must be edited in markup to reskin; copy (headline, subhead, nav labels, social-proof count) is hardcoded inline; the 'Switzer' display headline assumes Medium weight with tight tracking/leading so a substitute font may need metric tuning; the background video is an HLS (.m3u8) stream, so brand replacements must also be HLS-encoded for the hls.js pipeline.
